create.name: Tamal Dodge
create.bio:
Tamal Dodge grew up in Hawaii inside his family's yoga ashram, so practice and teaching were part of daily life for him from childhood. He went on to found Yoga Salt, first as a Los Angeles studio and now as a vinyasa studio in downtown Wilmington, North Carolina, where he still leads classes alongside a team of teachers. Over the years he has also made several instructional yoga DVDs aimed at beginners and at energy and relaxation, and he has toured to give workshops and teacher trainings around the United States.

Teacher training is the centre of his work. His 200-hour course mixes asana, breathing practice and alignment with yogic philosophy, meditation, the subtle body and the history of yoga, and the studio reports more than a thousand graduates. With JJ Cook he also runs an advanced 300-hour immersion in Costa Rica. Outside the classroom he hosts meditation sessions, and with his wife Victoria he wrote The Yoga Plate, a vegan cookbook built around ahimsa, the principle of not causing harm; the two are now planning plant-based cooking classes at the studio. He describes his aim as helping students live peacefully in the world without being swept along by it, and to treat yoga as a whole way of living.

books.title: The Yoga Plate
books.author: Tamal Dodge and Victoria Dodge
books.description: A vegan cookbook written with his wife Victoria that ties everyday cooking to the yogic idea of non-harm. Its recipes are grouped to follow the rhythm of a day of practice, from morning smoothies to desserts.

courses.title: 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training with Tamal Dodge
courses.description: A ten-week weekend programme at Yoga Salt in Wilmington leading to the RYT200 certificate. It covers asana, sequencing, pranayama, anatomy, the subtle body, philosophy and meditation.

courses.title: 300-Hour Advanced Yoga Teacher Training Immersion
courses.description: An advanced residential training in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, led with JJ Cook for graduates of a 200-hour course. Room, board and meals are part of the fee.

courses.title: Private Yoga Sessions at Yoga Salt
courses.description: One-to-one or small-group sessions at the Wilmington studio, shaped around the student's own practice. Packages of three or five sessions are also offered.

courses.title: Yoga Salt Group Classes
courses.description: Weekly vinyasa classes at the downtown Wilmington studio, from music-led flows and inversion practice to yin and restorative sessions. New students can start with an introductory offer.
